kinds.d: Threaded fastener with a head, used with a nut; its strength is shown as a property class.
Internally threaded fastener that mates with a bolt or stud.
Flat or spring ring set under a nut or head to spread load or lock it.
Fastener set by deforming its tail, including blind (pop) rivets.

notes: All four kinds kept; old blank-maker models (coach/roof bolt, hexagon/nylon lock/connector nut, penny/repair washer) became types. No models remain.
